newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products firmer, gas oil trade muted.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products firmer, gas oil trade muted.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Thursday, with naphtha bolstered by stronger crude.
Gasoline ended higher, with premium unleaded barges up $8 on crude's strength, the arbitrage staying open to the U.S. and healthy demand, including into the U.K.
Naphtha ended modestly higher tracking crude and swaps, a trend expected to continue.
Low sulphur cracked fuel consolidated Wednesday's gains to break post Gulf War highs. High sulphur fuel was steady with little interest in either bunkers or cargoes.
Gas oil prices firmed around $3 on futures but trade was slowed by uncertainty over Tuesday's record delivery into the November expiry.
